inputs.prompt:
Using the reference image only as a STYLE reference, apply its material rendering, lighting, and painterly treatment. Do not copy its subject, composition or background. The art style should be rough concept art sketches without much detail: bold, loose dry-brush strokes, visible bristle texture, chunky angular brushwork, scattered paint specks.

This is a decorative edge strip, layered along one edge of a card in front of a painted background.
Edge: bottom
The subject grows from that edge of the image and spans its full width, cut off by the left border, the right border and that edge. It fills at most half of the image's height; the rest of the image stays empty. The subject is a mostly flat, brightly coloured shape with little interior detail and a ragged, irregular silhouette line, never a straight horizon.

Description: A heap of skulls piled on top of each other, tilted at different angles, a few jawbones and broken bones wedged between them, empty eye sockets
Use following color palette: warm bone ivory, pale ochre, bright amber highlights on the brows and cheekbones

The empty area is a flat, pure black background with no texture, no strokes and no gradient. Keep all paint specks and splatter attached to the subject, never loose on the black.
No text, no border, no frame.
